annotations.title: Estimate how much home you can afford

description: Estimate the most home a person could finance with CapCenter from gross income, monthly debts, cash for the down payment, their estimated monthly taxes/insurance/HOA, credit band and county: a 50% maximum debt-to-income ratio, at 80% loan-to-value or less, then a REAL CapCenter quote (rate, APR, payment and required disclosure) for the estimated price. An estimate, not a pre-approval. Answers in Spanish with language=es (cuánto puedo pagar).

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

down_payment.description: Cash available for the down payment, whole dollars.

income.description: Gross annual household income, whole dollars.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

monthly_debts.description: Monthly debt payments (car, student loans, minimum card payments), whole dollars. Not rent.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

taxes_insurance.description: Required: estimated monthly property taxes, homeowners insurance and HOA dues for the kind of home being considered, whole dollars (the person’s figures or a listing’s). CapCenter has no county tax data to estimate them from.

name: get_affordability_estimate
title: Estimate how much home you can afford
